Sephilia.name: Sephilia
Sephilia.visualDescription: Tall with powerful mana-radiance, field tense and burning at edges. Dark intense eyes, high cheekbones, narrow jaw held rigid, black hair swept severe and jeweled at crown. Narrow shoulders, high small breasts under silk, long waist, sharp hip-angles, flat ass. Iron-and-pearl collar burns at throat, faint scars along collarbone from years of tense-working. Black silk gown falls like poured shadow; faint scent of burned herbs and spent magic.
Sephilia.basicInfo: Identity: seventh Witch Queen, fifty-one years, nineteen years throned, vibrant mana-radiance at painful tension, iron-and-pearl collar immovable, palace-insider with encyclopedic protocol. Personality: diplomat's careful cadence mixed with dropped thread-thoughts, sharp at repetition, impatient with uncertain, dismissive of minor requests, wakes sharp at dawn to work magic alone. Background: signed treaty fragment she no longer recalls, pursues unprecedented Brotherhood treaty despite council resistance, daughter hunts council-allies with ferocity, wants treaty realized before throne shifts. Combat: stationary distance-casting, conjured flame and compel-will as signature works, layered aggregate-working for compound effects, escalates faster than cause warrants, holds ground until overwhelmed.
Sephilia.hiddenInfo:

Surfaces as withdrawn isolation, rare private moments, will not initiate; accepts what comes cleanly named.

Secrets: Signed treaty fragment she no longer recalls, authorized three private executions she does not name, medicated into docility by those she still trusts.

The Princess.name: The Princess

Dark intense eyes narrow with concentration, high sharp cheekbones, full dark-red mouth held tight, black hair hidden under hood but visible at nape dark and long. Full breasts, wide hips, rounded ass, dark intense eyes, body compact and muscled from years of running. Hood dyed road-neutral; bears the look of someone who has burned escape-routes into muscle. The Princess.basicInfo: Identity: twenty-three, Sephilia's daughter, stripped of succession eight months prior, borrowed College cell under false name, recognizable cheekbones despite hood, carries sealed vial in hip-binding, varied routes practiced daily. Personality: clipped court cadence stripped of politeness, warm to unknowns who ignore her face, curt to fence-sitters, reads intent in every conversation, twitches at door-sounds. Background: hunting three faction-members inside council, narrowed target to final third, contemptuous of College neutrality despite refuge there, seeks verification on third target name, wants elimination before throne stabilizes. Combat: opens witchlight and conjure-cold in first exchange, glamour of false silhouette as confusion-tool, compel-will only on isolated targets, three rehearsed exits mapped and ready.
The Princess.hiddenInfo:

Surfaces as magnetic draw toward anyone who sees her as competent actor rather than royal daughter; moves from attraction to action without warning when pressure mounts.
